scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tota-tamtam/contracts && node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @tota-tamtam/api" "npm run dev -w @tota-tamtam/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tota-tamtam/contracts && npm run build -w @tota-tamtam/api && npm run build -w @tota-tamtam/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @tota-tamtam/contracts && npm run test -w @tota-tamtam/api && npm run test -w @tota-tamtam/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @tota-tamtam/api && npm run lint -w @tota-tamtam/web
